name: AutoThrottle
description: Dynamically optimize your upload/download speeds while Plex, Jellyfin or Emby is playing in realtime.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database and encryption key. Keep this folder to keep your settings and history.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User that owns the appdata folder.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group that owns the appdata folder.

variables.name: Username
variables.description: Optional. Sign-in username from here instead of creating an account in the WebUI. Set together with the password.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Optional. Sign-in password, set together with the username.

variables.name: Disable sign-in
variables.description: Turns off sign-in. Only use this behind a reverse proxy that handles sign-in itself.
